name: lead-generator-pro
description: Multi-worker Google Maps Lead Generator (Modularized Architecture)
author: Hetansh Patel <developer@leadgenerator.com>

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:frontend && npm run sync:dist && electron --no-sandbox .
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:frontend && npm run sync:dist && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.dist:portable: npm run build:frontend && npm run sync:dist && electron-builder --win portable --x64
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:frontend && npm run sync:dist && electron-builder --linux AppImage
